title: Private connectivity from serverless compute to AWS-managed resources is now generally available
body: AWS Private Link from Databricks serverless compute to AWS-managed resources, such as S3 buckets, previously in Public Preview, is now generally available. Your data traffic remains entirely within the AWS network and never traverses the public internet. See [Configure private connectivity to AWS-managed resources](/aws/en/security/network/serverless-network-security/pl-aws-resources).

ref_links.text: Configure private connectivity to AWS-managed resources
